CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

----
